elements.element: Customer pays no liquidated damages or penalties.
elements.evidence: The Company, as Customer, must pay HDI a Termination Payment upon a qualifying convenience termination.

elements.element: Any Customer-payable liquidated amount is only an early-termination fee.
elements.evidence: The only Customer-payable liquidated amount in the rendered language is the Termination Payment triggered when the Company terminates for convenience, excluding termination for HDI breach or failure to perform.

elements.element: The early-termination fee is capped at three months of fees.
elements.evidence: The Termination Payment equals the aggregate Section 3.1 fees for the three calendar months preceding the Termination Date.

elements.element: The early-termination fee is the sole liquidated amount payable by Customer.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly states that the Termination Payment is the “sole and exclusive amount payable by the Company by reason of such termination,” and provides no other Customer-payable liquidated amount.
